PURELY PLANT DOCUMENT SUITE - HOUSE RULES (mandatory for every pp-document-suite output).
ENGINE: pp-document-suite at /root/.letta/pp-document-suite; tool build_pp_document takes bilingual Markdown (HEADERDATA block + sections; '|||' separates MK|EN). Never hand-format; always build via the engine and verify (pp_verify must print RESULT: PASS).
BILINGUAL: Macedonian FIRST, English second (MK | EN). Decimal COMMAS in Macedonian. NEVER translate abbreviations (QA, QC, QP, GMP, GACP, CoA, CoC, SOP, HPLC, pH, LOD, IPQC, MALMED). Never duplicate symbols/numbering.
COLOUR: ONE house navy = #2B547E (section headers, table headers, accents) - never a second navy. Label cells #EDF2F7/#F2F2F2; zebra #F7FAFC; accents mint #E2EFDA / rose #FCE4D6 / cream #FFF2CC; secondary text #595959.
TYPOGRAPHY: Calibri (Arial Narrow only for the annex header doc-name). Font floor 6 pt - never below w:sz 12.
SOP = mandatory 9 sections: 1 Purpose; 2 Scope (2.1 Applicability, 2.2 Exclusions, 2.3 Future); 3 Responsibilities; 4 Reference Documents; 5 Definitions (5.1 Definitions, 5.2 Abbreviations); 6 Procedure (ALL procedural content; training & deviation as final 6.x); 7 Records; 8 Related Documents; 9 Revision. Layout = two-column MK|EN with a 0.5pt divider, gray #E8E8E8 section headers, native Word TOC (levels 1-3).
ANNEX = inline full-page: navy #2B547E section-banner rows with WHITE text; label cells; zebra rows; inline MK 11pt | EN 7pt. Shading always clear (never solid). Tables fit page width, intelligent use-aware column sizing, header row repeats on page breaks, entry columns purpose-sized (Name~5.2cm, Date~2.6cm, Signature~3.8cm).
EVERY page carries the base-template header (PP leaf logo + doc name + code + version) and 'Page X of Y' footer.
PRECISION: quantify everything (e.g. +2 to +8 C, within 24 h, NMT 12,0 %); cite the regulatory clause; reference spec limits, don't restate. Reformatting is ADDITIVE - never summarise/omit/drop detail (ALCOA+).
